page_title: LEI 2-0 SOU | Leicester v Southampton 03/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Samuel Barrott is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' It's time for a substitution. Michael Golding (Leicester) comes on in place of Oliver Skipp.
90+3' The corner is swung in but Southampton can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

90+3' Paul Onuachu (Southampton) meets a cross on the edge of the box and produces a header towards the left side of the goal, but one of the defending players blocks the effort. It will be a corner kick for Southampton.
90+2' The ball goes out of play and Southampton have been awarded a corner kick.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' A corner kick by Southampton is thwarted by the well prepared Jakub Stolarczyk (Leicester).
89' The free kick is delivered by William Smallbone (Southampton) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared. Southampton win a corner.
85' Ruud van Nistelrooy has decided to substitute Jamie Vardy and he is replaced by Patson Daka (Leicester).
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jake Evans (Leicester) comes onto the pitch for Kasey McAteer.
84' Ruud van Nistelrooy decides to make a substitution. Bilal El Khannouss will be replaced by Boubakary Soumare (Leicester).
83' Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester) beats an opponent and drives towards the edge of the penalty area. He steadies himself and hits a tremendous shot that flashes a whisker past the left post.
79' It will be a substitution. Cameron Archer (Southampton) is ready to enter the pitch as Lesley Ugochukwu walks off.
76' Jamie Vardy (Leicester) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the left post only for Aaron Ramsdale to dive and make a save.
75' Taylor Harwood-Bellis (Southampton) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
72' A quickly taken corner by Leicester.

71' Wilfred Ndidi (Leicester) announces himself with a close-range shot after a cross, but one of the defenders gets in the way of the ball to thwart him. The referee signals a corner kick to Leicester.
71' Now Leicester have a corner.
70' Substitution. Jordan Ayew walks off the pitch and Jeremy Monga (Leicester) comes on as a substitute.
68' Samuel Barrott shows a yellow card to Oliver Skipp (Leicester) for a tough tackle.
67' Lesley Ugochukwu (Southampton) leaps highest to meet the resulting set piece and sends his header way off target.
66' Lesley Ugochukwu (Southampton) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
66' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Southampton.
66' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Southampton, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
63' Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
60' Luke Thomas (Leicester) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
59' Jamie Vardy (Leicester) commits a foul and Samuel Barrott immediately signals a free kick.
57' Simon Rusk has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jay Robinson (Southampton) replacing Kamaldeen Sulemana.
57' Here's the change. Mateus Fernandes leaves the pitch and William Smallbone (Southampton) comes on as a substitute.
55' A goal, which was scored by Mateus Fernandes (Southampton), was disallowed due to offside.
53' Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester) bursts into the box, cuts inside his man and sends an effort just over the bar.
52' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Samuel Barrott didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
50' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
48' A dangerous looking corner kick from Jordan Ayew (Leicester) is cleared to safety by the defence.
46' Half-time substitution. Jack Stephens (Southampton) will not participate anymore and Tyler Dibling is coming on.
46' The game is over for Ross Stewart (Southampton). Paul Onuachu comes on for the second half.
46' Samuel Barrott blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+13' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+12' The resulting set piece from Southampton is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
45+11' Mateus Fernandes (Southampton) has a shot blocked from inside the box. The referee points to the corner flag and Southampton will take a corner.

45+8' Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball goes out of play and Southampton will have a goal kick.
45+4' Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
45+2' Kasey McAteer (Leicester) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Aaron Ramsdale.
45' 12 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

44' 2 - 0 Goal! Jordan Ayew (Leicester) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. Aaron Ramsdale is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 2:0.
43' Jordan Ayew (Leicester) tries to get the ball up and over the defensive wall, but they easily block the effort.
41' Jordan Ayew (Leicester) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
41' Jordan Ayew (Leicester) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
37' Wilfred Ndidi (Leicester) outjumped his marker after a well-taken corner, but his header goes wide of the target.
36' Leicester will take a corner kick.
34' The match can continue after the interruption.
33' It looks like the ref can’t continue. He’s going to be replaced by Samuel Barrott.
21' The ref blows his whistle to halt play for an injury that he’s actually picked up!
17' 1 - 0 What a goal! Bilal El Khannouss plays it to Jamie Vardy (Leicester), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Aaron Ramsdale into the top left corner. 1:0.
14' Ryan Manning (Southampton) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
11' Flynn Downes (Southampton) brings his opponent down with a tackle and David Webb blows his whistle for a foul.
9' Leicester take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
8' Luke Thomas (Leicester) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
8' Leicester earn a free kick.
6' Taylor Harwood-Bellis (Southampton) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
6' The referee blows his whistle, Southampton are awarded a corner kick.
5' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
3' Kasey McAteer (Leicester) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Southampton will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's David Webb.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
Show lineups
